description: Posts one test lead to your email provider and reports whether the list answered and how long it took. Take it right after you connect the list, or after the form address changed: "Does the list still take my sign-ups?" It needs the session and the webinar. Say before you run it that one test entry will appear in that provider's list, so nobody wonders where it came from. Nothing on the campaign changes. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: test Mailchimp, list connection, test autoresponder, is my list connected, sign-up test

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

title: Test the connection to the email list
